cyber-security-101.title: Cyber Security 101
cyber-security-101.description: Your starting point in cybersecurity: Linux, networking, Windows and Active Directory, cryptography, web hacking and OWASP, exploitation, offensive tooling and defense, with hands-on practice from day one.

jr-penetration-tester.title: Jr Penetration Tester
jr-penetration-tester.description: From beginner to junior: methodology, passive (OSINT and social engineering) and active reconnaissance, Nmap, Burp Suite, scripting, privilege escalation, password attacks, pivoting and Active Directory.

webapp-pentesting.title: Web Application Pentesting
webapp-pentesting.description: Offensive web specialization with real labs: SQLi, XSS, SSRF, command injection, file upload, auth bypass, race conditions, API security and mobile apps.

advanced-pentesting.title: Advanced Pentesting (Red Team / PT2)
advanced-pentesting.description: Expert level: web red teaming and WAF evasion, advanced Active Directory, red team operations (C2 and exfiltration), container escape and cloud IAM, AI/LLM exploitation and binary exploitation.

start-your-cyber-journey.title: Start Your Cyber Journey
start-your-cyber-journey.description: What offensive security is, how to work ethically and legally, and how hands-on learning with rooms and flags is structured.

linux-fundamentals.title: Linux Fundamentals
linux-fundamentals.description: Terminal, file system, permissions and SUID, users, processes, packages, networking and automation: the base to attack and defend Linux systems.

windows-ad-fundamentals.title: Windows and Active Directory Fundamentals
windows-ad-fundamentals.description: The operating system of the corporate world: editions, Registry, UAC and the domain model with Kerberos.

command-line.title: Command Line
command-line.description: CMD and PowerShell: automation in the Windows world, from network diagnostics to object pipelines.

networking.title: Networking
networking.description: Networking basics, wireless security and Wireshark: the air as the perimeter and traffic as evidence.

cryptography.title: Cryptography
cryptography.description: Encryption, hashing, cracking, PKI and digital certificates, with practice.

exploitation-basics.title: Exploitation Basics
exploitation-basics.description: CVEs and public exploits, Metasploit, shells and binary reverse engineering with a lab.

web-hacking.title: Web Hacking
web-hacking.description: Anatomy of a web application, inspection with DevTools, client-side validation and Burp Suite as a full proxy.

offensive-tooling.title: Offensive Security Tooling
offensive-tooling.description: The offensive arsenal in practice: brute force with Hydra, content discovery with Gobuster and automated SQL injection with sqlmap.

defensive-security.title: Defensive Security
defensive-security.description: The other side: threat modeling, the SOC, phishing forensics, log analysis and the incident lifecycle.

security-solutions.title: Security Solutions
security-solutions.description: The technology of defense: SIEM, firewalls, IDS/IPS and vulnerability scanners.

defensive-tooling.title: Defensive Security Tooling
defensive-tooling.description: The defender's tools: SIEM and EDR in practice, REMnux/FLARE and the malware analysis method.

cyber-career.title: Cyber Career
cyber-career.description: Professional principles, a map of roles in the industry and your next learning step.

owasp-top-10.title: OWASP Top 10 (2025)
owasp-top-10.description: The ten most critical web risks: broken access control, injections, SSRF, supply chain and more.

pentest-foundations.title: Penetration Testing Foundations
pentest-foundations.description: Professional methodology: pentest phases, frameworks (PTES/OSSTMM), the cyber kill chain and the art of reporting.

recon-pasivo.title: Passive Reconnaissance
recon-pasivo.description: Deep OSINT and social engineering: the public information that feeds attacks on the human factor.

recon-activo.title: Active Reconnaissance
recon-activo.description: Host discovery, port scanning and version detection: the first direct contact with the target.

nmap.title: Nmap Pro
nmap.description: Advanced scan types, firewall/IDS evasion, NSE scripting and machine-readable outputs.

burp-suite.title: Burp Suite
burp-suite.description: Proxy, Repeater and Intruder in depth: the professional web testing workflow.

privesc.title: Privilege Escalation
privesc.description: Linux (SUID, sudo, cron, PATH) and Windows (services, tokens, AlwaysInstallElevated): from user to root/SYSTEM.

active-directory.title: Active Directory
active-directory.description: BloodHound, Kerberoasting, Pass-the-Hash and lateral movement: compromising the whole domain.

scripting.title: Scripting for Pentesters
scripting.description: A bash scanner, a Python fuzzer and chaining tools together: build your own arsenal.

pivoting.title: Pivoting and Tunneling
pivoting.description: SSH forwarding, proxychains SOCKS and chisel: moving through the internal network from a single foothold.

mobile.title: Mobile Security
mobile.description: Auditing Android apps: the APK inside out, static analysis and dynamic analysis with Frida.

sqli.title: SQL Injection
sqli.description: Hands-on SQLi exploitation against a real lab: detection, bypass, UNION SELECT and extraction.

xss.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
xss.description: Reflected and stored XSS against a real lab: JavaScript injection, cookie theft and bypass payloads.

ssrf.title: Server-Side Request Forgery
ssrf.description: SSRF with a real lab: reaching internal services, configs with secrets and cloud metadata (the Capital One attack).

injection-misc.title: Command Injection, File Upload and Log Injection
injection-misc.description: OS command execution, file upload bypass and log injection (CRLF/XSS in logs): RCE and forgery with real labs.

auth.title: Authentication Bypass
auth.description: Weak Basic Auth, JWT attacks and IDOR, and session hijacking and prediction: the most common ways to get around authentication.

api-logic.title: API and Logic Flaws
api-logic.description: TOCTOU race conditions, API attacks (BOLA/BFLA), GraphQL and WebSockets against dedicated labs.

web-red-team.title: Web Red Teaming
web-red-team.description: WAF bypass, polymorphic payloads and layered encoding: attacking protected applications without tripping the alarms.

ad-avanzado.title: Advanced Active Directory
ad-avanzado.description: Kerberos delegation (unconstrained/constrained/RBCD), ADCS abuse (ESC1-ESC8), NTLM relay and trust attacks.

containers-cloud.title: Containers & Cloud
containers-cloud.description: Container escape (privileged, docker.sock, capabilities) and IAM misconfigurations in AWS/Azure.

ai-llm-exploitation.title: AI/LLM Exploitation
ai-llm-exploitation.description: Direct and indirect prompt injection, tool abuse, exfiltration via markdown and the frontier of offensive security.

binary-exploitation.title: Binary Exploitation
binary-exploitation.description: The full classic stack overflow: the stack, EIP, shellcode and modern mitigations with ROP.

passwords.title: Password Attacks
passwords.description: Wordlists and mangling rules, offline cracking versus online attacks, password spraying and NTLM: the foundation of credential theft in Windows and Active Directory.

red-team-ops.title: Red Team Operations
red-team-ops.description: C2 beaconing with jitter, detection evasion and DNS exfiltration: operating inside the target network without making noise.
